% Invented fixture: LaTeX's boxes set their content in one unbreakable box, as latex.ltx and
% xcolor build it. \raisebox lifts a word, \colorbox grounds one, \fcolorbox and \fbox frame
% them, and url.sty's lowtilde sets an address's tilde in a raised box. A box around a minipage
% frames it whole, and a minipage raised by its own depth stands on its last line's bottom. Every
% word is invented.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage[lowtilde]{url}
\begin{document}
An invented line with a \raisebox{3pt}{raised} word and a \raisebox{-2pt}{lowered} one.

An invented \colorbox{yellow}{grounded} word, a \fcolorbox{red}{yellow}{framed ground} and an
\fbox{outlined} pair.

An invented address \url{https://example.org/~probe} keeps its tilde low.

\noindent\fbox{\begin{minipage}{120pt}An invented framed block of words.\end{minipage}}

\noindent\raisebox{\depth}{\begin{minipage}[b]{\textwidth}\raggedright
An invented block standing\\ on its own depth.\end{minipage}}
\end{document}
